title: What a group header's count counts
body:
**Chose:** a group header's count is every space drawn under it: its members plus their worktree spaces.
**Over:** counting only the spaces listed in the group.
**Because:** a worktree goes where its checkout goes, so it is drawn inside the group and is a space the owner sees there.
**Undo:** in `arrange()` (`lib/groups.js`), make `size` count `members.length`.

title: A group in the narrow rail
body:
**Chose:** in the narrow rail a group is one row of its own holding only its dot (empty when nothing reports), clickable to fold, with its unfolded members drawn under it as usual.
**Over:** hiding a group's members in the rail, or drawing no row at all when there is no dot.
**Because:** §6 says only "a group shows only its dot". Keeping the row keeps the fold reachable in the rail and shows where the group starts.
**Undo:** in `groupHead()` (`main.js`), skip the row when `collapsed` and `dot === null`.

title: Where make, rename and delete live
body:
**Chose:** `make`, `rename`, `remove` and `groupName` live in `mods/factory-prompt/lib/edit.js` with their own tests (`tests/group-edit.test.js`), and work on the list as stored: entries they do not touch are kept as they are, and `factory-spaces` still normalizes and prunes on read.
**Over:** importing them from `mods/factory-spaces/lib/groups.js`, or copying `readGroups` into the dialog.
**Because:** `herdr-app check` refuses `../factory-spaces/lib/groups.js`: "resolves outside the application directory". Editing the raw list needs no second copy of the reader.
**Undo:** if herdr-app ever allows sibling imports, move the four functions into `lib/groups.js` and import them from there.

title: The new-group control in the narrow rail
body:
**Chose:** `group-new` (a `folder-plus` icon, tooltip "New group") sits left of `space-new` and is hidden in the narrow rail, where the header keeps only the `+`; a group's name is not drawn in the rail either, so renaming is a wide-sidebar action.
**Over:** two 26 px controls in a rail under 160 px.
**Because:** the rail today shows only the `+`, and the slice did not say the new control joins it.
**Undo:** in `render()` (`mods/factory-spaces/main.js`), drop the `.when(!collapsed, …)` around `group-new`.

title: A mod cannot import another mod's file
body: `herdr-app check` fails on `import … from "../other-mod/lib/x.js"` ("resolves outside the application directory"); keep shared logic inside the mod's own `lib/`.

title: after slice-02
body:
**Covers:** slices 01, 02
**Gate:** 1 runs, 0 red, 0.1 min — caught: nothing. Driving the window caught a defect the gate did not (below).
**Prove:** FR-1, FR-3, FR-4: 3 of 3 rows driven in a scratch window (`VERIFY_HERDR_INPUT=x11`) with five spaces on fixture folders, `acme`/`globex` seeded into `shared.json` with the window stopped, and the fixture runs. Evidence: cp-1/groups-unit-tests.txt, cp-1/groups-drawn-order-dark.png, cp-1/order-ls-select-unfolded.txt, cp-1/order-ls-select-folded.txt, cp-1/restart-groups-emptied-before-fix.txt, cp-1/restart-order-fold-kept.txt, cp-1/restart-fold-kept-dark.png, cp-1/group-folded-block-dot-dark.png, cp-1/group-folded-block-dot-light.png, cp-1/group-folded-narrow-rail-dark.png, cp-1/close-grouped-space-shared-readback.txt, cp-1/group-new-dialog-open.png, cp-1/group-make-acme.txt, cp-1/group-made-acme.png, cp-1/group-rename-dialog-open.png, cp-1/group-rename-initech.txt, cp-1/group-renamed-initech.png, cp-1/group-delete.txt, cp-1/group-deleted-initech.png, cp-1/group-deleted-acme-space-loose.png. These stay the owner's: the header drag (slice 03), the dialog's look, and how the dot looks (`qa-guide.md`).
**Fixed:** On every start, the window emptied every group. `render()` pruned `space.groups` against `spaces()` before the core had listed any space, so every member read as closed and was written away. It broke FR-3's "order survives a restart" and FR-4's "a fold survives". Now `prune()` in `mods/factory-spaces/lib/groups.js` skips a group until `machines()` reports its machine `ready`. Changed: `mods/factory-spaces/main.js` passes the loaded machines, and `tests/groups.test.js` has a new test, "a group keeps its spaces until its machine's spaces have loaded". `make inner` is green. Leaks: none (clean). Seen and not touched: `space.colors` is pruned the same way on start (cloned from upstream), so space colors are reassigned after a restart. No row covers it.

title: A space dropped on a row across groups, other than leaving
body:
**Chose:** a loose space dropped on a grouped space's row, and a grouped space dropped on a row of another group, change nothing: the row is not a drop target (no accent line, no outline) and the release moves nothing.
**Over:** joining the row's group, or leaving and reordering in one drop.
**Because:** §4 names only "on a group header joins" and "a grouped space on a loose space's row leaves"; a row drop that also changed groups would be a second, undocumented way to join.
**Undo:** in `drop()` (`mods/factory-spaces/lib/groups.js`), return the join for a row whose `group` is set, as the header case does.

title: Where a joined or left space lands
body:
**Chose:** a join or leave writes only `space.groups`; the space keeps its place in the core order, so it lands first in a group it joins from among loose spaces, and last among loose spaces when it leaves. A loose row a grouped space would leave onto shows an accent outline, not the reorder line, since the space does not land at that row.
**Over:** also running `space.move` to put a leaving space at the row it was dropped on.
**Because:** the ordering loop rewrites the core order from the store after every change; a `space.move` in the same drop races it.
**Undo:** in `row()` (`mods/factory-spaces/main.js`), after `setShared` on a leave, run `space.move` to the target row's index once the store echo settles.

title: after slice-03
body:
**Covers:** slices 03
**Gate:** 1 runs, 0 red, 0.1 min — caught: nothing. Leaks: clean, no hits to fix.
**Prove:** FR-2, FR-3: 2 of 2 rows driven in a scratch window (`VERIFY_HERDR_INPUT=x11`, run cp2) with five spaces (shop, api on fixture repos; web, notes, docs on fixture folders), the factory layout installed from the checkout with fixture props, and the fixture runs. The harness cannot press and hold, so each join, leave and header move was written as `drop()` itself decides it: the store was read with the window stopped, passed through `drop()` from `mods/factory-spaces/lib/groups.js`, written back, and the window started again. Join: loose docs on acme's header, and docs is drawn and listed under acme. Leave: grouped shop on web's loose row, and shop is loose again. Order: globex's header dragged up onto acme's puts api ahead of shop and docs in `ls`, `space.select --index 3` selects api, and both hold after `bin/restart.sh`. `bin/input.sh click` on globex's header folds it (`groups.folded` is `["g-globex"]`, core order unchanged), and a click on acme's name opens Rename group without folding acme. Evidence: cp-2/drop-unit-tests.txt, cp-2/groups-seeded-ls.txt, cp-2/groups-seeded-dark.png, cp-2/join-docs-acme-ls.txt, cp-2/join-docs-acme-dark.png, cp-2/leave-shop-loose-ls.txt, cp-2/leave-shop-loose-dark.png, cp-2/order-unit-tests.txt, cp-2/order-globex-above-acme-ls.txt, cp-2/order-globex-above-acme-dark.png, cp-2/order-restart-kept-ls.txt, cp-2/order-restart-kept-dark.png, cp-2/header-click-folds.txt, cp-2/header-click-folded-dark.png, cp-2/header-name-click-renames.txt, cp-2/header-name-click-rename-dialog-dark.png. These stay the owner's (`qa-guide.md`): the drag of a space in and out of a group, the header drag with its accent line and outline, and what a drag looks like.
**Fixed:** none. Seen and not touched: space colors are reassigned on each restart (`space.colors` pruned on start, as CP-1 noted).
